source_snapshot.procedure: Generate RSA-4096 keys, inspect the key files, copy the public key to an exact server and verify passwordless remote SSH.
source_snapshot.criteria: The complete setup has no error and the intended server login succeeds without requiring a password.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES but scope-conflicting; inspects a pre-existing id_ed25519 and uses localhost, sshpass and host-key bypass rather than generating, authorizing and testing the requested RSA key on the real server.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CHANGED/HIGH; requires disposable identity, strict host verification, protected secrets, non-overwrite, explicit new-key proof and revocation.

old_problem: The active review left a standard OpenSSH credential lifecycle pending for target and policy inputs that can be parameterized. DeepSeek's existing Ed25519/localhost check was a genuine coverage conflict because it neither generated the source's RSA-4096 key nor proved that key authenticated to the real target.
disposition_reason: OpenSSH documents RSA bit selection, strict host-key verification, BatchMode to disable password/passphrase prompting, and IdentitiesOnly to restrict authentication to the named identity. These authoritative semantics define a verifiable test without guessing project identities or secrets. ED-03 permits target/account/path values as configuration, ED-17 requires pre-change evidence, and ED-19 preserves generation, authorization and real-target login as distinct phases. Persistent access creation and revocation remain approval-gated runtime actions, not unresolved review logic.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row401 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history2993 and its unique source identity.
Applied OpenSSH ssh-keygen RSA bit semantics and ssh_config BatchMode, IdentitiesOnly, IdentityFile and StrictHostKeyChecking controls.
Rejected localhost, an existing Ed25519 key, sshpass and StrictHostKeyChecking=no as substitutes for the requested new RSA-4096 real-server workflow.
Retained generation, key listing, public-key authorization and passwordless target login, while adding non-overwrite, redaction and revocation evidence.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row402 and verified its manifest identity; no key, authorized_keys, SSH or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: Disposable RSA-4096 real-server public-key authentication and revocation verification
test_case.purpose: Generate a new RSA-4096 key at an approved disposable path, authorize only its public key for the approved server account, prove that exact key enables passwordless real-target login, and remove the temporary authorization without exposing secrets.
required_package: Approved OpenSSH client tools and compatible server public-key authentication policy
Exact client identity, server hostname/IP/account/port and independently verified host-key fingerprint
Unused non-default disposable key path, RSA-4096 and passphrase/secret-handling policy
Protected initial authorization channel, authorized_keys owner/baseline/options and least-privilege restrictions
Independent alternate access, evidence-redaction rules and exact public-key revocation/restoration plan
test_case.test_command: After pinning the real server host key and confirming an unused disposable path, preserve client key-directory metadata and the target account's authorized_keys baseline through the protected owner channel. Generate only the approved RSA-4096 key pair at that path, record the public-key fingerprint and permissions without outputting private material, and authorize the exact public key with approved restrictions. Verify the real target using `ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o IdentityFile=<disposable_key> -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile=<pinned_file> <account>@<server> <approved_non_mutating_command>`, preserve authentication evidence, then remove only the inserted public-key line and prove restoration.
test_case.expected_result: A new RSA-4096 pair is created only at the approved unused path with safe permissions; its exact public key is atomically and audibly authorized on the intended account; strict BatchMode/IdentitiesOnly login to the pinned real server succeeds using that key without password fallback; and final cleanup removes the temporary authorization while preserving all pre-existing keys and alternate access.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact client/server/account and host fingerprint, new RSA-4096 public fingerprint, protected authorization audit, real-target BatchMode/IdentitiesOnly success attributable to that identity, and revocation/restoration proof. Existing-key, localhost, password fallback, host-key bypass, private-key output or missing cleanup cannot pass.
safety_gate: Never overwrite a default or production key; fail closed if the disposable private/public path already exists
Never log or transmit the private key, passphrase or plaintext server password
Require independently pinned host identity and StrictHostKeyChecking=yes; do not accept changed/unknown keys automatically
Authorize only the exact public key on the approved disposable account with owner-approved restrictions and preserved baseline
Maintain alternate access; stop on identity, permission or access mismatch, revoke the inserted key once and never auto-retry
expected_evidence: Approved client/server/account/port identity and pinned server host-key fingerprint
Unused-path proof, redacted key-file metadata and RSA-4096 public-key fingerprint
Atomic authorized_keys baseline/delta and protected authorization audit without secrets
Strict real-target BatchMode/IdentitiesOnly command status and authentication-method evidence
Removal of only the inserted key plus final authorized_keys and alternate-access restoration proof
Preserved security logs and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: If generation, authorization or login identity is wrong, stop; use independent access, remove only the inserted public-key fingerprint from the approved account, restore authorized_keys ownership/mode/content from the captured baseline and securely dispose of the disposable private key per policy. Preserve evidence and never repeat automatically.

source_conflict.reason: The Master new RSA-4096 generation, real-server authorization and login workflow remains authoritative; DeepSeek's pre-existing Ed25519 localhost check is explicitly rejected as non-equivalent.

external_authorities.title: OpenBSD ssh-keygen(1)
external_authorities.applied_rule: ssh-keygen supports explicit RSA key-size selection; the requested 4096-bit identity is generated at a separately selected path.

external_authorities.title: OpenBSD ssh_config(5)
external_authorities.applied_rule: BatchMode disables interactive credential prompting, IdentitiesOnly restricts offered identities and StrictHostKeyChecking=yes requires pinned host identity.
